_comment: Illustrative weights, not validated. They sum to 100 and a test enforces that. Re-weight for your own funnel.

components.label: Next step reached
ladder: taken to their boss or committee
asked for pricing, a business case or a pilot

components.label: Their own situations
components.definition: Specific situations, teams or problems the buyer described from their own company. Generic industry talk does not count.

components.label: Excitement
components.definition: Distinct explicit positive reactions. Capped, so one enthusiastic buyer cannot dominate the score.

components.label: Back-and-forth
components.definition: Buyer questions plus substantive turns, per 30 minutes.
components.short_call_rule: Calls under 15 minutes are bucketed on the raw count, not the per-30-minute rate. Extrapolating a 9-minute logistics call to half an hour manufactures engagement that was never there.

recorded_not_scored.label: Repeated our framing back
recorded_not_scored.why: The best available signal that the message landed, and the most dangerous to score: the moment it counts, reps fish for it and the signal dies.
